Welcome to my website!
I am Khoi Tran, a current Pathology PhD student in the Department of Pathology at Case Western Reserve University’s School of Medicine. My fascination for the cell and the intricate network that regulates cellular processes has driven my dedication to understanding molecular drivers and mechanisms of neurodegenerative diseases. My current project focuses on the mutations of the mitochondrial protein CHCHD10 contributes to ALS-FTD pathogenesis.
In my free time, I like to play/watch soccer (Arsenal COYG), cook, regain my ability to play guitar, and bargain on Facebook Marketplace.
